records.jp: はぁ……
records.en_original: *sigh*...
records.en_auxiliary: *sigh*...
records.en: *sigh*...

records.jp: ヒーナちゃん！
records.en_original: Hiiinaaa!
records.en_auxiliary: Hiiinaaa!
records.en: Hiiina-chan!

records.jp: な、なに……？　また何かあったの？
records.en_original: Wh-What is it? Did something happen?
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what is it? Did something happen?
records.en: Wh-What is it...? Did something happen again?

records.jp: 悪いけど、私……
records.en_original: I don't know if I....
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know if I...
records.en: Sorry, but I...

records.jp: ううん。そっちじゃなくて文化祭の話だよ
records.en_original: Oh, nothing like that. I wanted to talk about the culture festival!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, nothing like that. I wanted to talk about the culture festival!
records.en: No, not that. I wanted to talk about the culture festival.

records.jp: なんだ、そっちか……
records.en_original: Right, that...
records.en_auxiliary: Right, that...
records.en: Oh. That.

records.jp: そろそろ話し合わないと！<CR>一度隣のクラスの委員と打ち合わせに行こうよ
records.en_original: We've gotta start planning it eventually! We should go meet with the committee member from the class next door.
records.en_auxiliary: We've gotta start planning it eventually! We should go meet with the committee member from the class next door.
records.en: We should start discussing it soon!<CR>Let's go meet the committee member from the class next door.

records.jp: 隣のクラス？　それって……
records.en_original: The class next door? Isn't that...
records.en_auxiliary: The class next door? Isn't that...
records.en: The class next door? Isn't that...

records.jp: うん。特待科。<CR>文化祭の出し物は学年ごとにやるって聞いてない？
records.en_original: The special program, yeah. Didn't anyone tell you that each grade hosts their own event?
records.en_auxiliary: The special class, yeah. Didn't anyone tell you that each grade hosts their own event?
records.en: Yeah, the Special Class.<CR>Didn't you hear that each grade puts on one event for the culture festival?

records.jp: うちの高校は小さいしね
records.en_original: Our high school's pretty small, so our grade's only two classes. Our program and the special program.
records.en_auxiliary: Our high school's pretty small, so our grade's only two classes.
records.en: Our high school's pretty small, after all.

records.jp: そういえば聞いた……あれ？
records.en_original: Yeah, that does sound familiar... Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, that does sound familiar... Huh?
records.en: Yeah, that does sound familiar... Huh?

records.jp: あれって、隣のクラスの森川さん？　バレエで有名な
records.en_original: Isn't that Morikawa from the other class? You know, the famous ballet dancer?
records.en_auxiliary: Isn't that Morikawa from the other class? You know, the famous ballet dancer?
records.en: Isn't that Morikawa-san from the other class? You know, the famous ballet dancer?

records.jp: うちのクラスに何の用だろ？
records.en_original: I wonder what she's here for...
records.en_auxiliary: I wonder what she's here for...
records.en: I wonder what she's here for...

records.jp: 失礼。文化祭のことで話しに来たんだけど、<CR>このクラスの代表の人いるかしら？
records.en_original: Excuse me. I came to talk about the culture festival. Who's your class rep?
records.en_auxiliary: Excuse me. I came to talk about the culture festival. Who's your class rep?
records.en: Excuse me. I'm here to discuss the culture festival.<CR>Is your class representative here?

records.jp: それなら、白井さんだよ？　ほら、あそこ
records.en_original: You mean Shirai? She's right over there.
records.en_auxiliary: You mean Shirai? She's right over there.
records.en: You mean Shirai-san? She's right over there.

records.jp: 白井……？
records.en_original: Shirai?
records.en_auxiliary: Shirai?
records.en: Shirai?

records.jp: 日菜子！？　――やっぱりあなただったの！
records.en_original: Hinako!? So it WAS you!
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako?! So it WAS you!
records.en: Hinako!? I knew it was you!

records.jp: 更紗……。同じ高校だったんだ……
records.en_original: Sarasa... I didn't know you went to this school.
records.en_auxiliary: Sarasa... I didn't know you went to this school.
records.en: Sarasa... I didn't know you went to this school.

records.jp: それはこちらのセリフ！　なんであなたがここに？<CR>しかも、なんで普通科なんかにいるの！？
records.en_original: I could say the same! What are you doing here? And stuck in the regular program, of all things!?
records.en_auxiliary: I could say the same! What are you doing here? And stuck in the regular class, of all things?!
records.en: I could say the same! What are you doing here?<CR>And why are you in the Regular Class, of all places!?

records.jp: それは……
records.en_original: Well...
records.en_auxiliary: Well...
records.en: Well...

records.jp: はいはーい！　文化祭の話ね！
records.en_original: Aaaanyway! The culture festival, am I right?
records.en_auxiliary: Aaaanyway! The culture festival, am I right?
records.en: Okay, okay! We're here to talk about the culture festival!

records.jp: じゃあ廊下に行こうか！　ほら、ヒナちゃんも一緒に！
records.en_original: Why don't we take this conversation into the hallway? Come on, Hina, you too!
records.en_auxiliary: Why don't we take this conversation into the hallway? Come on, Hina, you too!
records.en: Why don't we take this conversation into the hallway? Come on, Hina-chan, you too!

records.jp: それで。いったいどういうことなの？
records.en_original: So, tell me. What exactly is going on here?
records.en_auxiliary: So, tell me. What exactly is going on here?
records.en: So, tell me. What exactly is going on here?

records.jp: あれ以来、どのコンクールでも見かけないし、何してたのよ！？
records.en_original: You're in the regular program, I don't see you at competitions anymore... Where have you been!?
records.en_auxiliary: You're in the regular class, I don't see you at competitions anymore... Where have you been!?
records.en: I haven't seen you at any competitions since then. What have you been doing!?

records.jp: それは……
仕方ないでしょ？<CR>ヒナちゃん、バレエやめちゃったんだもん
records.en_original: This is getting nowhere. Hina quit ballet.
records.en_auxiliary: What do you expect? Hina quit ballet, after all.
records.en: What do you expect?<CR>Hina-chan quit ballet.

records.jp: はあ！？
records.en_original: WHAT!?
records.en_auxiliary: WHAT?!
records.en: WHAT!?

records.jp: 何言ってるの？　バカじゃないの
records.en_original: What are you talking about? Don't be stupid!
records.en_auxiliary: What are you talking about? Don't be stupid!
records.en: What are you talking about? Are you stupid?

records.jp: ライム、バカじゃないよー
records.en_original: I'm not being stupid.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm not being stupid.
records.en: Lime isn't stupid.

records.jp: 日菜子がバレエをやめるなんて、<CR>世界が滅んだってありえないわよ！
records.en_original: Hinako would never quit ballet, not in a million years!
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako would never quit ballet, not in a million years!
records.en: Hinako would never quit ballet,<CR>even if the world ended!

records.jp: ホントだもん。<CR>ね？　ヒナちゃん
records.en_original: I'm telling you the truth. Right, Hina?
records.en_auxiliary: I'm telling you the truth. Right, Hina?
records.en: I'm telling you the truth.<CR>Right, Hina-chan?

records.jp: ……うん
records.en_original: ...She is.
records.en_auxiliary: ...She is.
records.en: ...Yeah.

records.jp: 嘘、でしょ。<CR>あの子が勝手に言ってるだけよね？　ねえ！
records.en_original: You're kidding. She's just making that up, right? Right!?
records.en_auxiliary: You're kidding. She's just making that up, right? Right?!
records.en: You're lying...<CR>She's just making that up, right? Right!?

records.jp: ……いや、ライムの言ったとおりだよ。<CR>私は、もう……
records.en_original: ...No, she's not. I just...
records.en_auxiliary: ...No, she's not. I just...
records.en: ...No. Lime was right.<CR>I...can't dance anymore.

records.jp: どうして！？<CR>あなた、あんなに踊れたのに……
records.en_original: Why!? But you were so good...
records.en_auxiliary: Why?! But you were so good...
records.en: Why!?<CR>But you could dance so beautifully...

records.jp: もしかしてスランプ？　そうよ、あなたがバレエをしないなんて<CR>ありえない。一時的なものなんでしょ？
records.en_original: Are you in a slump? That must be it. There's no way you wouldn't do ballet. This is just a temporary thing, right?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you in a slump? That must be it. There's no way you wouldn't do ballet. This is just a temporary thing, right?
records.en: Are you just in a slump? That's it. There's no way you'd stop ballet.<CR>This is only temporary, right?

records.jp: それとも何？<CR>私の上を行くための奇策を練ってる最中なのかしら？
records.en_original: Or, let me guess! You're in the middle of plotting a clever scheme to outdance me!
records.en_auxiliary: Or, let me guess! You're in the middle of plotting a clever scheme to outdance me!
records.en: Or what?<CR>Are you secretly planning some way to surpass me?

records.jp: 何とか言ったらどうなのよ！
records.en_original: Why won't you say anything!?
records.en_auxiliary: Why won't you say anything?!
records.en: Why won't you say anything!?

records.jp: ……あなたに何がわかるの？　ヒナちゃんは――
records.en_original: ...What do you know, huh?! Hina--
records.en_auxiliary: What do you know, huh?! Hina—
records.en: ...What could you possibly understand? Hina-chan--

records.jp: ライム！　落ち着いて
records.en_original: Lime! Calm down.
records.en_auxiliary: Lime! Calm down.
records.en: Lime! Calm down.

records.jp: ……何なの？
records.en_original: ...Talk to me.
records.en_auxiliary: What's going on?
records.en: ...What is going on?

records.jp: ……今日の放課後、屋上に来て。そこで話す
records.en_original: ...Meet me on the rooftop today after school. I'll explain everything there.
records.en_auxiliary: Meet me on the rooftop today after school. I'll explain everything there.
records.en: ...Meet me on the rooftop today after school. I'll explain everything there.

records.jp: ……はぁ。私、まだ納得してないから
records.en_original: Fine. But I still don't believe you've quit.
records.en_auxiliary: Fine. But I still don't believe you've quit.
records.en: ...Fine. But I'm still not convinced.

records.jp: ヒナちゃん……
records.en_original: Hina...
records.en_auxiliary: Hina...
records.en: Hina-chan...
